# Prose Quality Integration Fixture

EgoLint provides a consistent linting interface for repositories.

The platform centralizes configuration, executes compatible analysis tools, and
stores reports in predictable locations. Repository owners can select profiles,
add extensions, and document intentional exceptions.

## Workflow

1. Detect the repository profile.
1. Load the shared policy.
1. Run the selected analysis tools.
1. Publish the resulting reports.

This fixture uses direct technical language and avoids unnecessary repetition.
